messages:
lena: quick microcopy pass on two small things in the console: the "Export usage" tooltip and the cluster deletion confirmation modal. low churn but important for clarity + a11y.
chris: cool, drop the current strings?
marta: tooltip currently: "Export usage data". modal CTA: "Delete cluster" with subtext: "This action is irreversible."
aria: accessibility note: tooltip isn't keyboard focusable and we don't expose its text via aria-label on the icon button. also modal confirmation input is just a checkbox  not great for preventing accidents.
lena: proposed tooltip: "Download usage as CSV (includes timestamps and API keys if present)." shorter fallback: "Download CSV" on small widths.
chris: mentioning API keys in tooltip seems scary from a leakage POV. are we sure we want to call that out?
marta: good point. backend pr removes keys unless user includes them explicitly in the export options. so tooltip should avoid surprising detail. maybe: "Download usage as CSV. Configure columns in Export options."
aria: that helps. also suggest adding aria-describedby to the button pointing to a visually-hidden element so screenreaders get the longer helper text without exposing it in the tooltip markup only.
lena: updated tooltip copy suggestion: "Download usage as CSV. Configure columns in Export options." short: "Download CSV". aria helper id: export-usage-helper, text: "CSV includes rows per request and selectable columns. API keys are excluded by default."
chris: sounds good. about deletion modal: current CTA "Delete cluster" and subtext "This action is irreversible" is fine, but we want users to pause. proposal: replace checkbox with required typed confirmation like "type the cluster name to confirm" and change CTA copy to "Permanently delete cluster"
marta: long modal copy suggestion: "Permanently delete cluster 'prod-west-1'. This will remove running instances, stored logs, and telemetry. This cannot be undone. Type the cluster name to confirm." CTA: "Permanently delete" (danger) secondary: "Cancel"
aria: accessibility: ensure the confirmation input has aria-label "Confirm cluster name" and that focus lands there when the modal opens. Also add an explanatory aria-live region that updates with form validation errors (e.g., "Name mismatch").
lena: i'm also inclined to surface a link to the rollback/playbook for infra teams under the modal text: "Need to preserve logs? See export & retention docs." small link.
chris: good idea, makes it less scary. small UI nit: the typed confirmation should trim whitespace and be case-sensitive? prefer case-sensitive to avoid accidental match.
marta: yes, case-sensitive to be safe. we'll add a helper note: "Match the cluster name exactly (case-sensitive)."
aria: and for keyboard users: ensure primary button is disabled until the typed name matches exactly, and the aria-disabled state is present when disabled. also confirm role="alertdialog" for the modal so screen readers convey the danger nature.
lena: i'll update the Figma copy and variations for mobile. chris can you add translation keys: export.button.tooltip, export.button.tooltip_short, modal.cluster.delete.title, modal.cluster.delete.body, modal.cluster.delete.confirm_placeholder, modal.cluster.delete.cta
chris: on it. i'll also add test cases for i18n and make sure truncation works on narrow screens.
design-bot: UX preview uploaded: https://preview.redwood.app/changes/456  Visual QA requested.
marta: thanks, leaving this thread open for any last wording tweaks. if no objections by EOD we'll merge the patch.
aria: LGTM accessibility-wise, left a small comment about focus order in the preview.
chris: merging after CI + visual checks. :shipit:
